items.title: Show HN: Digital scarcity; app where photos gradually decay with time / views (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Like instagram, but all photos have a shelf life: they can be up for year, an hour or ten minutes, or up until they're viewed 100 times, 1000 times or a million times, etc. The longer they're up, the more they fade - user chosen filters are applied gradually over the lifetime of the photo (be it measured in clicks or time), gradually obscuring it. At the end of its lifetime, the pictures faded / expired, and disappears, though comments remain. This is a fun side project of mine, An experiment in digital persistence and scarcity. And, yes its vibe coded, built on replit. Currently just a responsive web page (desktop, and works great on iOS devices, which I have). Native apps for android and iOS to follow should interest and time permit! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49959138 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

items.title: Show HN: Build with Python - a beginner course where your code draws (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Hi HN, I built this because I watched my daughter struggle at learning Python. I made something that runs only in the browser with visuals rather than relying on CLI/terminal output. No need to worry about python installation, package versions, venv etc. The lab runs with Pyodide in a web worker, and the program output is a picture by the side of the code block. A user would experiment with the code, and see the immediate changes in the visual output. The course has 13 modules, with the first 6 foundation modules free, module 7-13 with free readings but guide labs for a one-time price of $49. Please give it a try at https://scimigo.com/en/learn/build-with-python Send me feedback on the UX and on the exercise design, especially if you teach kids to program. I am also working on a C++ version for beginners (also with browser, no gcc or command lines). stay tuned. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49956771 Points: 21 # Comments: 6
